question: What is the ratio of customers who pay in EUR against customers who pay in CZK?

details.reason: Complete results differ from Gold SQL; BIRD Soft F1 = 0.0
details.actual_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'EUR') AS eur_customers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'CZK') AS czk_customers,
  ROUND(
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'EUR')::numeric
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'CZK'), 0), 4
  ) AS eur_to_czk_ratio
FROM customers
WHERE currency IN ('EUR', 'CZK');
details.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM customers
